description: This file contains the implementation of the SafeAnalysisNodeVisitor class in the Twig templating engine. The class traverses Twig nodes to analyze and mark safety attributes (like 'html') for variables and expressions to prevent security issues like XSS. It manages safe variables and combines safety information across different node types, such as constants, blocks, filters, functions, and attribute access.

classes.name: SafeAnalysisNodeVisitor
classes.description: Implements a node visitor that analyzes Twig nodes to determine safe variables and expressions, primarily for security purposes like XSS prevention.

methods.name: setSafeVars
methods.description: Sets the list of variables considered safe without further checks.

methods.name: getSafe
methods.description: Retrieves the safety status for a given node, returning an array of safety tags.

methods.name: setSafe
methods.description: Assigns safety tags to a specific node.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Called when entering a node; currently returns the node unmodified.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Analyzes a node upon leaving to determine and assign its safety properties based on node type.

methods.name: intersectSafe
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two safety attribute arrays.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this node visitor; default is 0.
